data.name: Fariyah
data.gender_notes: Fariyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fariyah is an Arabic name for girls that means 'joyful', 'happy', 'cheerful'. The name Fariyah carries the meaning “Joyful, Happy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Fariyah usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, happy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reminds of the joy and happiness of faith.
data.etymology: Fariyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Happy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fariyah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: فريه
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الفرح والسرور والابتهاج
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فريه مشتق من الفعل فارى، وهو يعني الفرح والسرور والابتهاج، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة النمل آية ٦٤، وتستخدم هذه الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية للدلالة على الفرح والسعادة

in_urdu.name: فریحہ
in_urdu.meaning: خوشی اور مسرت کا معنی رکھنے والا مؤنث نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: فریحہ نام عربی زبان کے الفعل فارى سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشی اور مسرت، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں خوشی اور سعادت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: फरिया
in_hindi.meaning: ख़ुशी और आनंद का अर्थ रखने वाला स्त्रीलिंग नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: फरिया नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया فارى से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है ख़ुशी और आनंद, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में ख़ुशी और सुख की प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: فریا
in_pashto.meaning: د خوښۍ او مسرت معنی لرونکی ښځینه نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: فریا نوم د عربي ژبې د فعل فارى څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د خوښۍ او مسرت دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتني دودیزو کې د خوښۍ او سعادت د نښانې په توګه کارول کېږي

in_english.name: Fariyah
in_english.meaning: A feminine name conveying joy, happiness, and delight
in_english.long_meaning: Fariyah originates from the Arabic root 'f-r-y' signifying joy and happiness, mentioned in Quranic verses, symbolizing delight and bliss in Islamic tradition, reflecting positive personality traits

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name 'Fariyah' represents a sense of joy and happiness, which are highly valued virtues in Islamic culture. The name carries a warm and positive connotation, and it is often associated with a radiant and blissful demeanor.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context of Islam, the name Fariyah can be seen as a reminder of the immense joy and happiness that comes from connecting with Allah (God) and living in accordance with His guidance. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Paradise is under the shades and its shade is its thorny branches." (Bukhari) The name can also serve as a daily reminder for the joy and happiness that comes from being grateful for Allah's blessings and striving to do good deeds.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Fariyah symbolizes the radiant and pure joy experienced in the presence of Allah. It is a name reminding us of the eternal happiness and bliss in the Hereafter.
